title: Savory Chinese Congee
description: A comforting and flavorful Chinese dish made with rice and aromatic ingredients.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add sliced ginger and minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
Add congee and rice, stirring to combine.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the congee has thickened.
Stir in chopped scallions and season with salt to taste.
Optional: serve with your choice of toppings such as sliced green onions, pickled ginger, or diced scallions.
